title: Carta and NewView Partner on Startup Employee Stock Sales
excerpt: Carta and NewView have launched a new program to help startups allow employees to cash out early through tender offers.
body_html:
Carta and NewView have formed a partnership aimed at encouraging more startups to permit their workers to cash out their shares earlier.

The collaboration introduces a new program designed to simplify the process of executing tender offers. By making these transactions easier to manage, the companies hope to entice a larger number of startups to offer early liquidity options to their employees.
